commits.subject: AJCR G-4 (c3)/(c4) kernel-flattening brick: Picard/SlicingFlatKernel — over Noetherian R, a submodule L <= ker f (f : M -> N between finite flat modules) whose residue-fibre images span every fibre kernel forces L = ker f, M/ker f and N/range f flat, and ker f finite projective with rankAtStalk = the fibre-kernel dimension (= g when constant). Engine layer (mathlib-general, no Noetherian): a fibrewise-injective map from a finite(ly presented) module into a finite flat module is injective, has projective source and flat (locally free) cokernel — split at each maximal localization via IsLocalRing.split_injective_iff_lTensor_residueField_injective + Module.free_of_lTensor_residueField_injective, globalized by projective/flat/injective_of_localized_maximal; the residue fibre of the localized map is the original fibre (LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct + cancelBaseChange). No new Noetherian induction needed; the k[eps] counterexample is excluded exactly by the fibrewise-spanning hypothesis (elements of (eps) die in the fibre).
